description: Execute a command inside a capsule and return stdout, stderr, and the exit code. Provide the command as an argv array, e.g. ['ls','-la','/workspace']. Commands first: files, installs, settings, scripts and data are one call here, a fraction of a second, where the screen takes many steps. On a Linux desktop capsule it runs as the desktop user 'capsulate' (home folder, DISPLAY :1, so apps open on the shared screen); prefix 'sudo' for root. On Windows pass ['powershell.exe', '-Command', '<script>']: it runs in the desktop session's PowerShell, about 0.3 s. It works while a person holds the screen.
name: capsulate_exec
title: Run a command
